title: On the Hersch-Weinberger inequality in higher dimensions
summary: We investigate a reverse Faber-Krahn type inequality for the Robin Laplacian in a bounded smooth domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$ whose boundary has two connected components. We prove that a concentric spherical shell maximizes the first eigenvalue over a class of such domains under perimeter and volume constraints, and under an additional convexity assumption when $N \geq 3$.
